findings.description: Measurement fields shoulder_width_cm and inseam_cm correctly added as DOUBLE to align with existing measurement fields in V1 baseline.
Frontend validation only checks for min="0", whereas backend enforces specific ranges (e.g., Height 50-300cm, Weight 20-500kg). Users may receive 400 errors from API without clear UI guidance.
findings.fix_suggestion: Sync HTML input min/max attributes with backend @DecimalMin/@DecimalMax values in BodyProfileRequest.java.

findings.description: Registration wizard measurements step lacks range validation, mirroring the issue in the profile page.
findings.fix_suggestion: Add min/max props to NumberField and apply backend-consistent ranges.

findings.description: Successfully replaced brittle comma-splitting with robust ObjectMapper JSON parsing for list fields (styleAesthetics, etc).
Method-aware rate limiting correctly targets PUT /api/auth/me (10/min) without affecting GET /api/auth/me hydration calls.
Tests updated with decimal values (38.5, 76.25) and properly verify BodyProfile persistence via ArgumentCaptor.
